text:
ana.newhire: Hi team — I accepted the org invite but I still can't see the private repos (404). I accepted with my work email but GitHub redirects to my personal account. Anyone know the usual fix?
jamie-peopleops: welcome Ana! tagging IT: @it-support-bot — can you check the invite state?
it-support-bot: Checking now. Quick questions: did you use SSO when accepting? Do you have 2FA enabled on the personal account?
ana.newhire: I clicked the link from my laptop. It asked to sign in and then SSO screen flashed; I have 2FA enabled on my personal account but not yet on the work email (I didn't set up account).
it-support-bot: Got it. Looks like the invite tried to attach to your personal GH account because the email is already associated. Two paths: (A) add your work email to your personal account and accept then remove association (messy), or (B) we can send an invite that requires a separate account for the work email and force SSO to your org. Which do you prefer?
devex-lucy: Also FYI: if you want to keep one account, you can add the work email to personal and then enable org SSO via Settings > Organizations. But if you prefer separation, ask IT to use the "create new account" invite flow.
nana.newhire: I'd prefer separation if possible — don't want to mix personal stuff.
sam-eng: if you need repo access quickly, add me and I'll fork a private onboarding template for you; but better to get teams set up. You should be in mobile-team + onboarding.
it-support-bot: Sending a fresh invite now using the "require new account" option and marking SSO required. Also pre-added to mobile-team and onboarding with read access to redwood/mobile-app. Invite sent at 2026-03-03T14:12:05Z.
nana.newhire: Received it, tried accept and it prompted to create account password then SSO. When I complete SSO it errors: "SSO provisioning blocked: organization requires 2FA."
it-support-bot: That means the org requires 2FA for new accounts. Can you enable 2FA on the account creation page (recommended: use authenticator app) and try again? Quick steps: 1) follow create account flow, 2) Settings > Security > Enable two-factor auth, 3) choose authenticator app, scan QR, enter code.
nana.newhire: Enabled 2FA and accepted. Now I can see redwood/mobile-app and onboarding. Thanks!
jamie-peopleops: Awesome — added a checklist DM with next steps (SSH key, add to GitHub Teams, get access to CI secrets if needed). Ping me if anything still missing.
sam-eng: Welcome aboard Ana :tada: — once you clone, run `yarn install` and `yarn start`. If you need write perms on a repo, open an access request in infra/repo-access and tag @sam-eng.
devex-lucy: Pro tip: if you ever hit SSO redirect loops, try `gh auth login --web` and pick your work org that will avoid account conflation.
nana.newhire: All good now — can clone and opened an access PR for a branch. Thanks everyone! :smile:
